set.body:
The plan of record is docs/plan.md. This item is the umbrella for the MVP.

The MVP is done when real people complete four journeys on an instance inside the institute network, using one real de-identified study: bring a study in from the legacy XNAT, see it, share it between labs, and publish it as open and FAIR.

Order of work (owner's rule, 19 November 2026)
1. Core. The technical core is in place and rock solid before any user journey begins. The CORE item defines that as a finite list. Core items carry the tag phase-core.
2. Journeys. Real people try the four journeys only after the core gate has closed and the journey scripts pass on the pilot host (RUN5). We begin them believing they will pass.
The console screens (tag phase-surface) are designed and built alongside the core, on engine pieces that are already done.

Done when
1. The core gate is closed: CORE.
2. The four journey rehearsals pass: IN6, SEE8, SHARE5, OPEN5.
3. The pitch pack is ready: PITCH1 and PITCH2.

How to work
- Work only items tagged mvp. List them with: mote ls --tag mvp. Core first: mote ready --tag phase-core.
- Narrow by journey (journey-in, journey-see, journey-share, journey-open, journey-run, journey-pitch) or by track (track-engine, track-console, track-tools, owner).
- Everything else is tagged later and blocked by the GATE item, so mote ready lists only MVP work.
- New scope needs the owner's yes. Reviews and audits add notes to existing items.
- The journey scripts (CORE1) run on every change. RUN4 reports weekly.

History: this item was EP10, the 17 November demo epic. Its closed children D01 to D07 and D10 delivered the Stage 1 curator workflow and the file viewers. The remaining D items were rewritten into the journeys.
